comparison.objective: Hot-swap a failed drive sled without disturbing healthy bays; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Latch-button hold, sled extraction, guided insertion, and detent seating versus hex-key unlocking, fine collar rotation, locking, and guarded test cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Replacement seated with green lamp and healthy sleds unmoved versus two safe repeatable stops. Candidate response thresholds are partly undeclared.
comparison.reason: Guided hot-swap insertion does not test adjustable damping calibration.
